findings.title: Countdown and goal plate covers the match clock and reaches the centre
findings.detail: On the sideways phone, the countdown/goal plate sits on top of the match bar. The clock 'T-10:00' is half hidden behind it, and the plate reaches down into the centre 20% box. DESIGN: Goal line puts the goal line under the match bar on touch, not over it. Desktop keeps the bar clear.
findings.evidence: countdown@phone.png: the plate overlaps the score bar and clock at the top centre. The plate's bottom edge reaches about y 190 CSS. The centre box spans y 156-234 and x 338-506.
findings.fix: Anchor the countdown/goal plate below the match bar (top = bar bottom + 8 px) and cap its height, so it stays above the centre box on 844x390.

findings.title: Range stats panel is cut off at the top edge
findings.detail: On the phone, the Practice Range stats panel starts at y 0. Its first row, 'Time to kill', sits at y -1 and is clipped by the screen edge. It ignores the safe area, which is about 47 px on the long edge. Desktop is inset properly.
findings.evidence: range-hud@phone.dom.json: 'Time to kill' box [28,-1,58,17]. The panel spans about [16,0,204,258].
findings.fix: Offset the panel by max(env(safe-area-inset-top), 16px), with the side inset taken from env(safe-area-inset-left).

findings.title: Empty recoil box takes up the left side of the phone HUD
findings.detail: The 'Recoil of the last burst' graph shows as an empty black box before any shot is fired. On a 390 px tall screen, it blocks a large share of the left view and gives the player nothing to act on.
findings.evidence: range-hud@phone.png: an empty dark box at the left, about [28,98,180,150] CSS.
findings.fix: Hide the recoil graph until the first burst. On phone, collapse it into the stats panel or behind a tap.

findings.title: Way to play is below the fold on the sideways phone
findings.detail: Several Battle Royale controls are below the fold on the phone: the 'Play on' picker (Local bots) and the map readouts need a scroll, and the Squads picker is half under the footer. DESIGN: Layout requires the way to play to show without a scroll on a sideways phone. royale-local@phone has the same problem, made worse because the Name field takes the top of the screen.
findings.evidence: royale@phone.dom.json: Squads picker [16,316,169,48]. The footer starts at y 338. The Play on picker has y > 390.
findings.fix: On short landscape screens, put the pickers in two columns, or move the Name field and readouts after the pickers, so that Play on and Squads fit above the footer.

findings.title: Bot Match settings hidden below the map tiles on phone
findings.detail: Only the map tiles are visible on the phone. Mode, Sides, Skill and Players all need a scroll, and 'Random map & mode' sits under the footer. A player can start without seeing the mode or the bot skill.
findings.evidence: bot-lobby@phone.dom.json: 'Random map & mode' [16,330,812,44] overlaps the footer at y 338. The Mode and Skill pickers have y > 390.
findings.fix: On landscape phones, shrink the map tiles to one row, or move them into a picker, so the Mode, Sides, Skill and Players fields fit above the footer.

findings.title: Unlit destination 'Play Online' too faint over the map
findings.detail: On the phone main menu, the unlit 'Play Online' entry is drawn in #8b8e92 straight over the 3D scene. It measures below the 3:1 needed for large text. #8b8e92 is --ds-text-3, which DESIGN: Colour reserves for labels on plates, so this also breaks the design system.
findings.evidence: contrast.md main-menu@phone: 'Play Online' p50 2.4, p10 1.6, need 3.0.
findings.fix: Use --ds-text-2 (#b3b5b8) for unlit destinations, or put the list on a dark scrim.

findings.title: Name field is a 19 px tall target
findings.detail: The callsign input in the profile corner is 19 px tall on desktop, against a 32 px minimum. On the phone it is [598,26,218,19], against a 44 px minimum for touch.
findings.evidence: main-menu@desktop.dom.json: input [1550,60,298,19].
findings.fix: Give the input min-height 32px on desktop and 44px on touch, keeping its plate.

findings.title: Loadouts missing from the secondary row
findings.detail: DESIGN.md specifies a Loadouts / Profile / Settings row under the destinations. The menu shows only Profile and Settings. The same is true on the phone.
findings.evidence: main-menu@desktop.png: the bottom row has Profile [68,956,103,44] and Settings, and no Loadouts entry.
findings.fix: Add the Loadouts entry to the row, or update DESIGN.md if it moved deliberately.

findings.title: Profile corner lacks the next-unlock line
findings.detail: DESIGN.md says the profile corner shows Rank in the light plus a next-unlock line. The corner shows only 'Rank 1' and 'Observer · 0 / 800 XP', with no line saying what the next rank unlocks.
findings.evidence: main-menu@desktop.png top right, about [1468,40,396,98].
findings.fix: Add one line under the XP readout naming the next unlock (for example 'Rank 2: <item>').

findings.title: No primary action; Reset profile weighs the same as Back
findings.detail: The profile footer holds only Back and the destructive 'Reset profile', both drawn as equal graphite plates, side by side with no separation. Nothing is lit, so there is no obvious next step, and the destructive action sits exactly where a primary usually goes. Desktop has the same footer.
findings.evidence: profile@phone.dom.json: Back [16,338,117,44] and Reset profile [141,338,169,44], with the same style.
findings.fix: Move Reset profile away from Back (into a danger area, or behind a confirm), and style it as a danger or quiet control.

findings.title: Profile states the same facts twice
findings.detail: Each weapon row says 'No kills yet' next to a 'Kills 0' readout. The rank block says both '0 XP of 800' and '800 XP to Rank 2'.
findings.evidence: profile@desktop.dom.json: 'No kills yet' [801,209,58,17] beside 'Kills 0' [1106,183,23,17]. XP lines are around [108,196,629,20].
findings.fix: Keep the Kills readout and drop 'No kills yet'. Keep one XP sentence (for example '800 XP to Rank 2') next to the bar.

findings.title: Must-read sentences set at 13 px
findings.detail: Sentence-case text that players need to read is set at 13 px, below the 14 px minimum. Only short uppercase labels may go down to 12. Examples on the profile: 'No kills yet', '25 to level 1', 'New at midnight'. The same 13 px size appears in the royale 'why' line [56,207,218,17], the range stats, the settings notes, the pause Controls descriptions and the footer key hints. contrast.md flags 55 size warnings on profile alone.
findings.evidence: contrast.md profile@desktop: rows sized 13 under the 14 threshold. The DOM shows IBM Plex 13/400.
findings.fix: Raise the body/note step of the type scale from 13 to 14 or more. Keep 13 only for short uppercase labels on plates.

findings.title: Movement hint shrinks to 13 px on phone
findings.detail: The first-play hint 'Move. The mouse looks' is 16 px on desktop but drops to 13 px on the phone. Phone body text must be at least 14 px.
findings.evidence: range-hud@phone.dom.json: hint [394,350,123,17], 13 px.
findings.fix: Keep the hint at 16 px on phone (the body step).

findings.title: Settings tabs only 4 px apart
findings.detail: The settings tabs are 44 px tall but only 4 px apart, against the 8 px minimum gap between targets. Desktop uses the same 4 px gap.
findings.evidence: settings-controls@phone.dom.json: tabs [141,10,99,44] and [244,10,139,44], a 4 px gap.
findings.fix: Set the tab gap to 8px.

findings.title: Section heading repeats the lit tab
findings.detail: With the Audio tab lit, the panel opens with an 'Audio' heading that restates the tab. The Touch tab has the same problem.
findings.evidence: settings-audio@desktop.dom.json: h2 'Audio' [56,119,70,29] under the lit Audio tab.
findings.fix: Drop a section heading that matches the tab name. Keep headings only when a tab holds several groups.

findings.title: Disabled Solos/Duos/Trios picker gives no reason
findings.detail: The squad size picker is disabled but shows no reason. Solos is still drawn lit, so it looks chosen and active. DESIGN.md asks that a disabled control say what it is waiting for.
findings.evidence: royale@desktop.dom.json: the squad buttons are disabled:true and sit in [56,279,520,48].
findings.fix: Add a short reason next to the picker (for example 'Online only'), and dim the lit plate while it is disabled.

findings.title: Player name shown in both the Name field and the squad slot
findings.detail: The local royale screen shows your name in a full-width Name field and again in your squad slot.
findings.evidence: royale-local@desktop.dom.json: Name field [760,719,1104,46] and the same name in the squad slot.
findings.fix: Make the squad slot the editable name, or drop the separate field.

findings.title: Some buttons render in IBM Plex instead of Chakra Petch 600
findings.detail:
DESIGN.md sets controls in Chakra Petch 600. Several .ds-btn controls render in IBM Plex Sans Condensed 400 instead:
- 'Check again' in the online footer
- 'Run benchmark' on benchmark (22/400 IBM on desktop, 16/400 on phone)
- loadout tile names and key binds
The two buttons on one footer then look like different families.
findings.evidence: online@desktop.dom.json: 'Check again' [1604,1008,260,58] in IBM 400. benchmark@desktop.dom.json: 'Run benchmark' button.ds-btn.primary.big in IBM 22/400.
findings.fix: Make the .ds-btn primary/big variants inherit font-family and weight from the base .ds-btn.

findings.title: Field labels have two different styles
findings.detail: The .ds-field-label class renders at 16/700 #fbf6ec in the bot lobby ('Mode'), but at 13/400 #b3b5b8 in the royale lobby. The same role gets two steps of the scale.
findings.evidence: bot-lobby@desktop.dom.json: 'Mode' [1344,383,38,20] 16/700. royale@desktop.dom.json: field labels 13/400.
findings.fix: Pick one label style for .ds-field-label and remove the bot-lobby override.

findings.title: Page title same size as section headings
findings.detail: On the phone, the 'Benchmark' title is 22 px, the same as the 'This machine' and 'Results' section headings, so the page has no visible title step. Desktop uses 52 px.
findings.evidence: benchmark@phone.dom.json: h1 'Benchmark' [16,8,140,29] 22 px, and h2 'This machine' [16,57,153,29] 22 px.
findings.fix: Use the 32 px title step for phone h1s.

findings.title: Your seat has no role line
findings.detail: DESIGN.md says your lobby seat reads 'You · Host'. The seat shows the name only.
findings.evidence: bot-lobby@desktop.png: seat [57,214,398,50].
findings.fix: Add the role line to your own seat.

findings.title: Error text repeats the buttons
findings.detail: The line 'Try again in a minute, or play a Bot Match.' restates the two buttons directly below it.
findings.evidence: error@desktop.dom.json: the line at [84,894,405,20], above the Try again and Bot Match buttons.
findings.fix: Drop the sentence, or replace it with the actual cause.

findings.title: Done and pending steps differ only by dash shade
findings.detail: On the connecting screen, completed and pending steps use the same text colour. Only the shade of the leading dash changes, so the state is carried by colour alone.
findings.evidence: connecting@desktop.png: the step list at [84,830,160,81].
findings.fix: Mark done steps with a check (or strike or dim the text) and the current one with a spinner.

findings.title: Loading percentage uses proportional digits
findings.detail: The '42%' readout is not tabular, so it jitters as it counts up. The slider values on settings-mouse are not tabular either.
findings.evidence: loading@desktop.dom.json: '42%' [84,856,170,109] without tabular-nums.
findings.fix: Add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to the progress figure and the .val readouts.

findings.title: Caption plate covers an ally name tag
findings.detail: On the phone, the caption plate near the top centre sits on top of the ally tag 'Rook', so the teammate's name is hidden while it is up.
findings.evidence: match-hud@phone.dom.json: caption plate [250,108,344,36] and ally tag 'Rook' [416,135,28,17].
findings.fix: Draw world-space ally tags above HUD plates, or move the caption higher, under the match bar.

findings.title: Health and ammo figures sit too close to the bottom edge
findings.detail: The large health and ammo figures end about 41 px from the bottom edge. The 3% safe area at 1920 is about 58 px.
findings.evidence: match-hud@desktop.dom.json: '100' [76,961,101,78], whose bottom is at y 1039.
findings.fix: Raise the bottom HUD anchor to about 3vw (58 px).

findings.title: 'Click Resume' hint repeats the Resume button
findings.detail: The footer hint 'Click · Resume' names the same action as the lit Resume button at the top of the list. The rule says a button never sits beside a key hint for the same action. Phone has the same footer.
findings.evidence: pause@desktop.dom.json: hint 'Click' [261,1003,32,17] + 'Resume' [309,1003,43,17]; button RESUME [56,135,440,73].
findings.fix: Drop the 'Click Resume' hint, and keep Move and Select.

findings.title: '1 kills' plural error in the MVP line
findings.detail: The MVP line reads '1 kills'. The count is not pluralised correctly.
findings.fix: Pluralise by count: '1 kill' / 'N kills'.
